WITH DomainTables AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        VALUES
            (
                'DimCurrency',
                'Currency dimension',
                'One row per currency',
                'Contains currency codes and currency names used to interpret sales transactions.'
            ),
            (
                'DimCustomer',
                'Customer dimension',
                'One row per customer',
                'Contains customer identity and demographic attributes. It connects customers to geography through GeographyKey.'
            ),
            (
                'DimDate',
                'Date dimension',
                'One row per calendar date',
                'Contains calendar attributes used to group sales by day, month, quarter, semester, and year.'
            ),
            (
                'DimGeography',
                'Geography dimension',
                'One row per geographic location',
                'Contains city, state or province, postal code, and country attributes. It connects customers to sales territories.'
            ),
            (
                'DimProduct',
                'Product dimension',
                'One row per product',
                'Contains product names, pricing, cost, color, size, model, and product classification attributes.'
            ),
            (
                'DimProductCategory',
                'Product category dimension',
                'One row per product category',
                'Contains the highest-level product classification, such as Bikes, Components, Clothing, and Accessories.'
            ),
            (
                'DimProductSubcategory',
                'Product subcategory dimension',
                'One row per product subcategory',
                'Contains product subcategories and connects each subcategory to a product category.'
            ),
            (
                'DimPromotion',
                'Promotion dimension',
                'One row per promotion',
                'Contains promotion names, types, discount percentages, and effective date ranges.'
            ),
            (
                'DimSalesTerritory',
                'Sales territory dimension',
                'One row per sales territory',
                'Contains sales territory region, country, and geographic group attributes.'
            ),
            (
                'FactInternetSales',
                'Internet sales fact table',
                'One row per Internet sales order line',
                'Contains Internet sales measures including order quantity, unit price, discount, product cost, sales amount, tax, and freight.'
            )
    ) AS x (
        table_name,
        business_name,
        grain_description,
        business_description
    )
),
PrimaryKeyColumns AS (
    SELECT
        ic.object_id,
        ic.column_id
    FROM sys.indexes AS i
    INNER JOIN sys.index_columns AS ic
        ON ic.object_id = i.object_id
       AND ic.index_id = i.index_id
    WHERE i.is_primary_key = 1
),
ColumnDetails AS (
    SELECT
        s.name AS schema_name,
        t.name AS table_name,
        c.column_id,
        CONCAT(
            '- ',
            QUOTENAME(c.name),
            ' ',
            UPPER(ty.name),
            CASE
                WHEN ty.name IN ('varchar', 'char', 'varbinary', 'binary')
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        '(',
                        CASE
                            WHEN c.max_length = -1 THEN 'MAX'
                            ELSE CAST(c.max_length AS varchar(10))
                        END,
                        ')'
                    )
                WHEN ty.name IN ('nvarchar', 'nchar')
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        '(',
                        CASE
                            WHEN c.max_length = -1 THEN 'MAX'
                            ELSE CAST(c.max_length / 2 AS varchar(10))
                        END,
                        ')'
                    )
                WHEN ty.name IN ('decimal', 'numeric')
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        '(',
                        CAST(c.precision AS varchar(10)),
                        ',',
                        CAST(c.scale AS varchar(10)),
                        ')'
                    )
                ELSE ''
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN pk.column_id IS NOT NULL THEN ' [PRIMARY KEY]'
                ELSE ''
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN c.is_nullable = 1 THEN ' [NULLABLE]'
                ELSE ' [REQUIRED]'
            END,
            CASE
                WHEN ep.value IS NOT NULL
                    THEN CONCAT(
                        ' - ',
                        CAST(ep.value AS nvarchar(2000))
                    )
                ELSE ''
            END
        ) AS column_line
    FROM sys.tables AS t
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s
        ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
    INNER JOIN DomainTables AS dt
        ON dt.table_name = t.name
    INNER JOIN sys.columns AS c
        ON c.object_id = t.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.types AS ty
        ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id
    LEFT JOIN PrimaryKeyColumns AS pk
        ON pk.object_id = c.object_id
       AND pk.column_id = c.column_id
    LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties AS ep
        ON ep.major_id = c.object_id
       AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id
       AND ep.name = 'MS_Description'
),
AggregatedColumns AS (
    SELECT
        schema_name,
        table_name,
        STRING_AGG(
            CAST(column_line AS nvarchar(max)),
            CHAR(10)
        ) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY column_id
        ) AS column_documentation
    FROM ColumnDetails
    GROUP BY
        schema_name,
        table_name
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(
        'table:',
        ac.schema_name,
        '.',
        ac.table_name
    ) AS document_id,
    'table_catalog' AS document_type,
    'internet_sales' AS domain,
    DB_NAME() AS source_database,
    ac.schema_name,
    ac.table_name,
    CONCAT(ac.schema_name, '.', ac.table_name) AS qualified_table_name,
    dt.business_name,
    dt.grain_description,
    CONCAT(
        'TABLE: ',
        QUOTENAME(ac.schema_name),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(ac.table_name),
        CHAR(10),
        'BUSINESS NAME: ',
        dt.business_name,
        CHAR(10),
        'DOMAIN: Internet Sales',
        CHAR(10),
        'GRAIN: ',
        dt.grain_description,
        CHAR(10),
        'DESCRIPTION: ',
        dt.business_description,
        CHAR(10),
        CHAR(10),
        'COLUMNS:',
        CHAR(10),
        ac.column_documentation
    ) AS content
FROM AggregatedColumns AS ac
INNER JOIN DomainTables AS dt
    ON dt.table_name = ac.table_name
ORDER BY
    ac.table_name;

WITH DomainTables AS (
    SELECT table_name
    FROM (
        VALUES
            ('DimCurrency'),
            ('DimCustomer'),
            ('DimDate'),
            ('DimGeography'),
            ('DimProduct'),
            ('DimProductCategory'),
            ('DimProductSubcategory'),
            ('DimPromotion'),
            ('DimSalesTerritory'),
            ('FactInternetSales')
    ) AS x (table_name)
),
Relationships AS (
    SELECT
        fk.name AS foreign_key_name,
        ps.name AS source_schema,
        pt.name AS source_table,
        pc.name AS source_column,
        rs.name AS target_schema,
        rt.name AS target_table,
        rc.name AS target_column,
        fkc.constraint_column_id
    FROM sys.foreign_keys AS fk
    INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns AS fkc
        ON fkc.constraint_object_id = fk.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables AS pt
        ON pt.object_id = fk.parent_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS ps
        ON ps.schema_id = pt.schema_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns AS pc
        ON pc.object_id = pt.object_id
       AND pc.column_id = fkc.parent_column_id
    INNER JOIN sys.tables AS rt
        ON rt.object_id = fk.referenced_object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS rs
        ON rs.schema_id = rt.schema_id
    INNER JOIN sys.columns AS rc
        ON rc.object_id = rt.object_id
       AND rc.column_id = fkc.referenced_column_id
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DomainTables AS dt
        WHERE dt.table_name = pt.name
    )
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM DomainTables AS dt
        WHERE dt.table_name = rt.name
    )
      AND fk.is_disabled = 0
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(
        'relationship:',
        source_schema,
        '.',
        source_table,
        '.',
        source_column,
        '->',
        target_schema,
        '.',
        target_table,
        '.',
        target_column
    ) AS document_id,
    'relationship_catalog' AS document_type,
    'internet_sales' AS domain,
    DB_NAME() AS source_database,
    source_schema AS schema_name,
    source_table AS table_name,
    CONCAT(source_schema, '.', source_table) AS qualified_table_name,
    foreign_key_name,
    source_column,
    CONCAT(target_schema, '.', target_table) AS referenced_table,
    target_column AS referenced_column,
    CONCAT(
        'RELATIONSHIP: ',
        QUOTENAME(source_schema),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(source_table),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(source_column),
        ' references ',
        QUOTENAME(target_schema),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(target_table),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(target_column),
        '.',
        CHAR(10),
        'JOIN CONDITION: ',
        QUOTENAME(source_schema),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(source_table),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(source_column),
        ' = ',
        QUOTENAME(target_schema),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(target_table),
        '.',
        QUOTENAME(target_column),
        CHAR(10),
        'DOMAIN: Internet Sales',
        CHAR(10),
        'FOREIGN KEY: ',
        foreign_key_name
    ) AS content
FROM Relationships
ORDER BY
    source_table,
    foreign_key_name,
    constraint_column_id;
